# PCMag

> PCMag provides expert-tested product reviews, buying guides, and technology recommendations across computers, mobile devices, networking, security, and consumer electronics.

PCMag is a leading technology publication offering comprehensive reviews and comparisons of hardware and software products. The site features hands-on testing, expert recommendations, and buying guides to help consumers make informed tech purchasing decisions across all major product categories.

## Key Topics

- Product Reviews
- Buying Guides
- Laptop Reviews
- Gaming Hardware
- Smartphones
- Tablets
- Desktop Computers
- Graphics Cards
- Networking
- Cybersecurity
- Software Tools
- Consumer Electronics
- Editors' Choice
- Best Picks
- Hardware Comparison

## Computing Devices

- [The Best Laptops We've Tested (March 2026)](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-laptops): Expert-tested laptop recommendations for budget, productivity, and gaming
- [The Best PCs (Desktop Computers) We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-desktop-computers): Desktop PC reviews and buying guide for towers, all-in-ones, and mini PCs
- [The Best Gaming Laptops We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-gaming-laptops): Gaming laptop reviews: MSI, Intel Core i7, RTX graphics, DDR5 RAM
- [The Best Phones We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-phones): Top smartphone reviews: iPhone, Android, Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel
- [The Best Tablets We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-tablets): Tablet reviews and recommendations for Amazon Fire, iPad, and Android

## Networking & Storage

- [The Best Wi-Fi Routers We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-wireless-routers): Wi-Fi router reviews and home networking recommendations from TP-Link
- [The Best External Hard Drives We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-external-hard-drives): External storage reviews: WD My Book, My Passport, USB-C hard drives

## Security & Software

- [The Best VPNs We've Tested (March 2026)](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-vpn-services): VPN service reviews: Proton VPN, privacy protection, online security
- [The Best Antivirus Software We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-antivirus-protection): Antivirus software reviews: Bitdefender, Norton, malware protection
- [The Best Password Managers We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-password-managers): Password manager reviews: NordPass, Proton Pass, security tools
- [The Best Web Hosting Services We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-web-hosting-services): Web hosting reviews: HostGator, Liquid Web, shared, VPS, cloud hosting

## Audio & Video

- [The Best Headphones We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-headphones): Headphone and earphone reviews: Sony, Apple AirPods, noise cancellation
- [The Best TVs We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-tvs): TV buying guide: OLED, QLED, LED, HDR recommendations for all budgets
- [The Best Video Editing Software We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-video-editing-software): Video editing software reviews: Adobe Premiere, CyberLink, content creation

## Gaming & Graphics

- [The Best Graphics Cards We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-graphics-cards): GPU reviews: Nvidia GeForce, AMD Radeon, Intel Arc gaming hardware

## Optional

- [The Latest Technology Product Reviews, News, Tips, and Deals](https://www.pcmag.com): PCMag homepage: tech reviews, news, buying guides, deals, and AI tools
- [The Best Tech Brands for 2026, Ranked](https://www.pcmag.com/articles/the-best-tech-brands-for-2026): Annual ranking of 25 best tech brands based on lab testing and reader choice
- [The Best All-in-One Printers We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-all-in-one-printers): Multifunction printer reviews: Brother, Canon for scan, copy, fax, print
- [The Best Printers We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-printers): Printer reviews: HP LaserJet, Epson EcoTank, inkjet vs laser buying guide
- [The Best Robot Vacuums We've Tested (March 2026)](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-robot-vacuums): Robot vacuum reviews: Ecovacs, self-emptying, AI obstacle avoidance
